name: Sill Line, Squared
tagline: Sill Line's greeting still stands on its lit week, now read top to bottom and squared up with the main camp's parts: one type system, a steel branch of ways to start, plates on the rail, a square tick, rule heads, a spend needle and a lamp key in every foot.
concept: The family's week is a lit line, and the page stands on it. Home reads question, box, then the sill, where the Next up tube and the later plans' ink plates stand on one rail lit only from now to stop one. Everywhere else the page is matte slate, steel and ink, with one type system and one legend, so the light means something wherever it is.
companions: Steel #56708c rails, rings and the tick square; slate #161c20 boards and keys; ink plates #1a2230 with a pale plate-cap #86a9cc top edge for what the family put on the calendar (Home's plates, the month's plans, the family's chat bar); amber #ffb850 only for late words, the setup strip's edge and current ring, and 'needs a look'; sage #86d9a6 for done and 'now' words; each kind's own grounded colour in its ring and its word only. The bright #6dff9c is kept for the mark, Send and the primaries, 'plan', the now lamp and the run to stop one, the tubes, live lamps, focus and the your-turn ring.
title: What needs a *plan*? It keeps what the judges praised in 'What needs planning?' (it cannot be answered no, and pulls in reminders, ideas and wishes as well as weekends) and fixes the one fault every lens named, the heavy eight-letter lit word: 'plan' is four letters, so the halo stays compact at 3rem, and it sits right above the lit run of plans that answers it. It says FamilyDB's job: anything the family hands over that needs a plan.
decisions: Started from t3-track-graft's files; the cross is one new source, src/cross.css, appended last by build.py, and the parent's Home sections in sill.css and ticked.css were deleted rather than overridden (sheet 192 KB of 200 KB). Tokens kept; bubble-them #1a2230, a plate-cap #86a9cc, and the ink plates everywhere (Home, the month, the plans list) moved to #1a2230 with #34404b steel sides.

Type system written once at the top of cross.css: display 3rem (the question only), title 2.25rem, head 1.5rem, all Archivo at 75% width 650 in the heading colour; body 1rem/1.55 DM Sans; small .875rem; label .75rem Archivo 600 caps at .08em. DM Mono only for clock times, day numerals, the Home date and margin dates. Counts stand on their title's baseline ('4 open · 3 late', '12 ideas · 10 on the line', '4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00').

Home is one board read top to bottom: eyebrow (her screen at 2rem, Vera, the date in DM Mono), the question at 3rem, then the box (7fr) beside the ways to start as a steel branch (5fr, Trued, Relit's T3-01): a junction ring 'Or start with' level with the box's top, a level run in from the box, 44px slate keys on ring stops, a T buffer. The junction lights in the phosphor while the box has words in it.

The sill: the Next up tube at 26rem with 14rem of glass stands on the rail at the left; right of it the station board ('Coming up' at head size, '4 coming' on its baseline, the Calendar note in small dim) level with the tube's top, and the later plans as ink plates sharing the width (flex 1, min-width 0), bottom-aligned, each on a 1px leg to a steel ring stop. Each plate: kind ring and kind word in label caps, the name in Archivo 75% 600 at 1.125rem, two lines at most, balanced, 'Mount St. Helens' held together, 'for Maya', the time in a sunk DM Mono well and 'in 7 days' in sans.

The now lamp sits at the board's inner padding with a white-hot core and a breathing halo; the lit run goes from it to stop one only, and the airglow rises off that run alone (masked to it). Stop one onward is steel #56708c to a T buffer whose label, 'All plans', hangs under it. Days hang under every stop (DM Mono 1.5rem figure, month over weekday in .75rem caps), stop one's day lit. I dropped the white-hot head that ran along the run on opening: in the capture it was caught mid-run as a dark blot.

The board's frame is steel line-2 with only a 1px phosphor highlight on its top edge, faded at the ends; the board's own green radial is gone; the box's resting halo cut by about 40%; 'plan' keeps E1 in two layers (6px at 55%, 22px at 22%).

Setup is a slate strip with a 3px amber left edge; ring 1 amber and current, rings 2 and 3 steel, all 44px; 'All 3 steps' at row size; 'Next: choose your own password' with 'so everybody signs in as themselves' under it from 64rem up.

To do (Home and page): Desk Terminal's column heads and lit NOW tick rebuilt on Sill's rail. The stop is a 1.375rem square, 4px radius, 2px #56708c edge, filled so the rail passes behind; hover and focus fill it surface-3 with the phosphor check at 45%, focus adds a 2px phosphor ring; aria-label 'Mark done: {title}'. Late boxes stay steel and the amber is in the words, in a DUE column in DM Sans; the undated box is solid. The NOW tick is a steady 1px phosphor line across the list with 'now' in the margin, coming up bright and settling over 1.2s. Heads: 'Day', 'Tick when done' over the rail, 'Thing to do', 'Who', 'Due', 'Edit'. I used 'Day' over the margin rather than the brief's second 'Due', so the two columns are not both called Due.

Rule heads (Backlit Plate) everywhere a section has a head: the condensed head, a 1px steel line-2 rule, and the count and links on the same baseline at the right ('4 open · 3 late · All 4'). The same treatment is given to every .section-head, panel head and the month's head, so Status, Settings, General, Chat and Plans share it.

Lately added comes onto the line: a steel rail whose stops are the kind rings (the ring is the lamp, in its kind's colour), the name in body 600, the kind word after it in its kind's colour at .8125rem, 'for Maya, Theo' in a right column. The right-aligned grey kind column is gone; the Ideas list takes the same coloured kind word.

Status is one graphite faceplate, a 2px bezel, 12px radius, holding two windows of scanlined glass: the named lamp board (working lamps breathe again, E20) and Desk Terminal's moving-coil meter rebuilt on a square-root scale over the limit (0, 0.10, 0.50, 1.00, 2.00), so the average day ($0.04) sits about 13% up the arc as a dashed ghost needle while today's hot needle with halo and white tip rests at $0.00; an amber band 75-100% and a red hatched overrun past the limit; '$0.00 TODAY' in VT323 at top left. Under the plate one line of big condensed tallies with their lamps, zero states hidden, 'needs a look' in amber.

Ideas: the line from home calmed. A square-root scale with no jog, mileposts only at 15 min, 30 min, 1 h and the end, at most five stations carrying '#n · time' (spaced at least 14% apart so none collide), the rest as unlabelled dots; pointing at a row still names its station under the line.

Plans: the head is one count that agrees with the list ('4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00'); quiet weeks are a 1px dashed steel run with the range in small dim on it (no end lamps). Chat: the family's plates are neutral surface-2 with a 3px plate-cap bar; the your-turn ring has E4's 3px ring and halo.

Every page's foot (base.html copied from the repo): the foot stands on a steel rail running from the mark's lit stop to a T buffer, and over the mark a lamp legend in .75rem label caps (Dessau Phosphor's shape key rebuilt): now (a breathing lit dot), to come (a steel ring), done (a sage ticked square), needs a look (a half amber lamp), not set up (a dashed ring), yours (a small ink plate with its cap).

Phone: headline, box, the branch stacked under the box, then the tube; the rail turns down the left gutter from the now lamp, lit to stop one under the tube's chin, where the wire runs right and up into the power lamp; the plates become 44px rows (day, name, time) on that rail. Home's To do rows fold to title and who over the due words.

Revision: the board now stands ON the sill. It has no bottom border, and the steel rail runs 1rem past both of its sides, with the T buffer and 'All plans' at the rail's own right end. Status's meter pivots inside its glass at bottom-centre under a steel cap with a phosphor dot. It sweeps a symmetric 105-degree arc on a square-root scale, labelled only at 0, 0.25, 1.00 and 2.00. The ghost needle carries 'avg $0.04' at its tip. The glass's row names are set in dim VT323 with no underline. To do's heads sit on one baseline, with 'Done' over the stops. NOW is one solid brand line on Home and on the To do page. The Ideas line names stations by short name on two tiers and gathers dots that would touch into tally dots. The form's stops are switches: required fields are filled, the field being written in is lit, and the rail ends in a buffer at Add it.
strengths: The line's identity survives and reads better: question first, box second, then the greeting standing on its lit week, with the lit run cut to its live stretch (now to stop one) and every other line steel.

One system across every page: one type scale, rule heads with their figures on the baseline, one tick, one plate, one legend in every foot, and every list on a rail whose stops are its lamps or controls.
The tick now looks like a control (a square box on the rail, hover fill and check, 44px), and late is said in amber words in its own column, never in the box.
Status's empty slate is gone: the named lamp board and a spend meter on a usual-day scale share one faceplate, and the tallies read in one line.
No sideways scroll and no target under 44px on any rendered page, smallest text 13px, 0 hard checks failed.
weaknesses: Home still measures about 65% green by coloured pixels, and Status about 69%. The hero tube, Send, the lit run and two windows of glass carry it. Calming the glow on the board's top and on the tube's outer bloom barely moved the number.
On Status, today's needle rests at $0.00 by truth, so only the ghost needle shows a usual day.

Several things are still worked out in templates: the Ideas line's label placement and tallies, Home's per-plan kind and people, the due dates and the month's counts. Each should become a field from views.py.
On the phone, the first screen shows the headline, the box and the branch; the turned-down rail and the plates sit below the fold.
The To do page hides its 'Day' head (the dates speak for themselves), so the margin's heading differs from Home's.
